name: c8_frozen
written: 2026-11-07, before any C8 search result was looked at
purpose: Large random search over per-person-calibration / model / smoothing choices on EDB, with a nested protocol so the winner's curse can be measured.

protocol.folds: same outer folds as C1; outer fold k: train = three folds, inner validation = fold (k+1)%5, test = fold k
protocol.selection: for each outer fold SEPARATELY, the configuration with the highest inner-validation AUROC is picked. Selection code never reads test columns. Test metrics of ALL configurations are logged only to measure how well validation rank predicts test rank (winner's curse).
protocol.secondary_selection: highest inner-validation sensitivity at 1% FPR (reported, not primary)
protocol.final_claim_rule: Search adds value only if the lower end of the 95% subject-bootstrap range of (nested-selected pooled test sensitivity at 1% FPR minus R1 = 0.120 from C2) is above 0. AUROC of the nested picks is descriptive.
protocol.config_prefix_rule: configs are random draws in one seeded order; the analysis uses the first N configs for which all 5 folds finished, N fixed by wall-clock time, not by looking at results

calibration: causal running median / MAD over previous span seconds of the person's own eligible beats (py/c8_prep.py), no labels
